name: Get feature toggles
description: Call this when you need to know whether specific optional features (e.g., tags, deduplication, AI assistant, SMS nudge banner) are enabled for the current account or context. Use a broader account‑settings action instead if you need more than just feature flags.

toggles.description: Comma‑separated list of feature toggle keys to retrieve, e.g. "tags_support,dp-contact-pipeline-enabled".

ai-assistant-enabled.description: True if the AI assistant feature is enabled.

dedup-customization-enabled.description: True if deduplication customization is enabled.

dp-contact-pipeline-enabled.description: True if the contact pipeline feature is enabled.

sms-nudge-banner.description: True if the SMS nudge banner is displayed.

tags_support.description: True if tag support is enabled.
